description:
Lists the aged payables in Xero.
  This shows aged payables for a certain contact up to a report date.

invoicesFromDate.description: Optional from date in YYYY-MM-DD format. If provided, will only show payable invoices after this date for the contact.

invoicesToDate.description: Optional to date in YYYY-MM-DD format. If provided, will only show payable invoices before this date for the contact.

reportDate.description: Optional date to retrieve aged payables in YYYY-MM-DD format. If none is provided, defaults to end of the current month.

name: list-aged-payables-by-contact
